Experience disappointed by the quality of the food and unprofessional staff
Feb 2026 • Couples
The setting is nice, beautiful view of Saigon...
The staff is very welcoming and very kind
The musicians are excellent 👏
The air conditioning is extremely strong!!
We took the Tet... New Year's Eve menu.
Unfortunately the quality of the dishes is not up to standard (the waygu is certainly excellent, the rest is average and not in the finesse)
There were 2 menus in all: that’s too many. Better to have a single menu with quality rather than a lot and medium...
The staff is sometimes hesitant and unclear.
Sometimes the staff wanted to rid when we did not finish eating and bring new dishes... ☹️
Moreover they ask us to pay the bill when we have barely started the 2nd menu and have not finished eating 😫
This is the first time I’ve seen it! This is not at all worthy of a great restaurant...! We need to review this and improve the service ...

Raw Wagu Chateaubriand. Nothing eaten and offered 10% off the bill to have it in a takeaway bag!!
May 2025 • Couples
My 70th birthday. Both ordered a snow aged Chateaubriand. Told it would take 20mins. Came after 40 mins. No issue, however they were both cold externally, raw and chilled in the middle. I expected them to be put back on the griddle, cooked properly and returned within a few minutes whilst the other food items were still hot. Not so. 40 minutes later the waiter came back and asked if we wanted ribeye instead. The answer was that we wanted our original order. This was not offered. All the other food was now stone cold so decided to leave. Stated I would not be paying as we had not eaten anything, due to them not cooking the food properly. We were not allowed to leave the restaurant. The food was all placed in a take away bag and we were offered a 10% discount off the bill!! I declined. Adam, the person I was dealing, accused me of being drunk despite only having half a bottle of wine between us.
Paid for the wine, but not the food, and eventually allowed to leave. His argument was that only the steak was cold and I should have to pay for what was hot. The fact that they had spoilt my 70th birthday was of no concern to them.
The speed the food was packed into a take away bag and a 10% discount was offered (with a straight face) indicates to me it is their normal policy. Never ever experienced anything like it anywhere in the world, no what what level of restaurant. Absolutely disgraceful from both Adam and his line manager, that I never saw or spoke to.

reviews.review_title: Review at Ussina Sky 77 - Aging Beef & Bar
reviews.review_text:
JimmyCapriCorns
Lake Dallas, Texas14 contributions
0
Don’t waste your money
Jan 2024 • Couples
There were lots of children, toddlers, running past tables, it was loud, it was not the environment I expected for such high prices, then they left and finally a conversation can be had. 

We ordered the set menu - the ONLY good plate was the Wagyu beef selection. The salad was a salad, nothing special, my god it was so overrated the remaining courses were nothing Japanese in quality. Some tempura thing was almost cold like they cooked buffet style not fresh, and some bizarre rice cake with imitation crab on top tasted horrible…I thought it was a joke. 

Overall, except the Wagyu, the food lacked flavor, it was bland, was not fresh prepared, and the service was mixed. Certainly,if you really want to say you went, I would avoid the set piece and order a salad with wagyu elections to share. The final insult came with the bill - We arrived at 8:30 and by 9:40 they asked us to review our bill, and pay, before our desert was served. This blew me away I have never had such unprofessional service. Ussina is not 4 or 5 star quality food service or presentation, only Wagyu beef on a wooden platter w a small hot stone…..I can name 100 better HCMC restaurants than this.
